meta.parties: Casim, Et Al. v. Dingihamy Et Al

rules.statement: An executor's sale of property burdened with a fidei commissum is not valid without the leave of the Court or proof of special circumstances, according to the blend of English and Roman-Dutch Law administered in Ceylon.
rules.supporting_quote: "I am of opinion that it would not be good. The executor, as an instrument in the administration of the estates of deceased persons, was imported into the Ceylon system of law as regards all persons in the opinion of the Judges in Staples v. de Saram( 1 Ram. (1868-1868) 275.) by the Charter of 1833. There appears no reason to doubt the correctness of the opinion of the learned Judges."
